rationale.conceptual: The core method is established DFT (PBEsol-GGA) combined with optical spectra and a quasi-harmonic Debye model. Implementing the Debye model from scratch involves non-trivial thermodynamics and numerical minimization, requiring careful translation of equations into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes ~5 distinct stages: geometry optimization with multiple volumes, SCF calculation, optical dielectric function computation, thermal property simulation (Debye model), and final result extraction. Each stage depends on prior outputs, requiring orchestration of Quantum ESPRESSO runs and custom post-processing scripts.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires a standard DFT workflow with non-trivial post-processing (Debye model) but no novel algorithms. The pipeline is multi-stage and relies on external tools, but no GPU is needed.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cell (12 atoms), moderate k-point grid, and no large datasets; all calculations fit comfortably on a single CPU core with a few GB RAM.
